annotations.title: CMBS loans with status, special servicing, DSCR, maturity and sponsor

description: Loans on the ACTIVE CMBS tape (SEC ABS-EE, each loan's latest monthly reading, read within 100 days of the newest period) with the servicer's own fields: payment status (current, 30/60/90 days, non performing matured balloon), special servicer and transfer date, whether it is in special servicing now, workout strategy, modification, current DSCR with its basis, occupancy, appraisal and LTV, balance, maturity, originator, and the sponsor as the prospectus annex discloses it (sponsor column, else carve-out guarantor, labelled). Each row carries the core property id where the building chain resolved it, for get_property_record. Filter by state, property type, maturity window, distress or sponsor text. The answer to 'Texas multifamily loans maturing in 18 months that are in special servicing, and who sponsors them'. Conduit CMBS only: bank balance sheet, agency and debt fund loans are not on this tape.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous page of this tool, unchanged.

distress.description: special_servicing: transferred and not returned; not_current: any payment status other than current; any: either.

dscr_max.description: Only loans whose latest DSCR is strictly below this (the current filing, else the last DSCR reported within 12 months; each row prints the period it was reported for). 'DSCR under 1.2' is dscr_max 1.2.

loan_keys.description: Specific loan keys (deal CIK:asset number) from a previous answer.

maturity_within_days.description: Loans maturing from today to today plus this many days.

sponsor.description: Sponsor or guarantor name contains, as the annex prints it.
